entities.name: PMID:19399307
observations: Review: amiodarone pulmonary toxicity commonly manifests as acute or subacute pneumonitis with diffuse infiltrates; prompt management includes amiodarone withdrawal and corticosteroids, usually for 4–12 months.

entities.name: Amiodarone pneumonitis treatment
observations: For suspected amiodarone pulmonary toxicity with diffuse infiltrates, withdraw amiodarone and treat with systemic corticosteroids; review notes corticosteroids are usually continued 4–12 months.
